varOutputVerified.title: Verified
varOutputVerified.description: Whether the OTP code was verified successfully.

varOutputMessage.title: Message
varOutputMessage.description: A user-facing message about the verification result.

varOutputSessionToken.title: Session Token
varOutputSessionToken.description: A session token generated on successful verification.
